survey_by: installer agent (manual; warp survey not implemented)

app.name: linkcheck
app.language: Go 1.24 (standard library only, go.mod has no requires)
app.version_source: none found (no version in go.mod / source; User-Agent says linkcheck/1.0)

files.reads: every .md/.markdown file under the directory given as argument (and -root); os.Stat of link targets inside it. Targets of relative links like ../x.md may resolve outside the scanned directory (inside the shell those simply do not exist).

network.egress: HEAD then GET to every http(s) URL found in the user's Markdown files; hosts depend entirely on user data (Known limitation, section 5). Uses HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY via Go default transport.
network.ingress: none in the application; tests start temporary httptest servers on random 127.0.0.1 ports

tests.command: go test ./... (inside shell: env HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/go-build /usr/local/go/bin/go test -count=1 -v ./...)
covers: external checks against local httptest servers (200/404/410/500/redirect/no-HEAD/flaky/timeout/refused)
tests.notes: go is at /usr/local/go/bin/go (not on PATH inside the shell); test temp dirs go to TMPDIR=/tmp
